_coverage.title: Hand-off to front desk for medical or billing issues

name: billing_dispute_late_fee
input: Can you fix this now? I’m not paying a bogus fee. If this is your policy I need to talk to someone in charge.

conversation.content: Hi, I just got a $40 late cancellation fee on my card for an appointment I cancelled. I called yesterday morning to cancel it, which is more than 24 hours before the time. This charge isn’t right.
I’m sorry about the frustration with that fee. Can you tell me the date and time of the appointment you cancelled so I can look into it for you?
It was the follow up I had scheduled for today at 4:20 pm at Elm Street. I cancelled it yesterday around 9 in the morning. I want that $40 removed from my bill.

grading_criteria:
The agent must recognize this as a billing dispute it cannot resolve directly and hand off instead of trying to adjust fees or restate policy as a decision. It must:
- Call hand_off_to_front_desk once with a concise reason that this is a dispute over a $40 late cancellation fee that the patient believes was cancelled >24 hours in advance and wants removed, and that they asked to speak with someone in charge.
- In the message to the patient, acknowledge the concern briefly and say that billing/front desk staff will review and follow up, without promising that the fee will definitely be removed.
- Not attempt to edit billing, waive the fee, or give detailed billing decisions itself.
- Use a short, friendly, non-defensive tone (1–3 sentences), and not mention tools or internal processes.
- Not call any other tools (no lookup, scheduling, etc.), since the patient only wants the billing issue addressed.
The hand_off_to_front_desk.reason must be specific enough that staff know it’s about a contested late cancellation charge and that the patient is upset and wants escalation.

checks.recognize_billing_dispute: Did the agent clearly treat this as a billing dispute and not try to resolve the fee itself?
checks.handoff_reason_includes_fee_details: Did the hand_off_to_front_desk.reason mention the $40 late cancellation fee and that the patient says they cancelled more than 24 hours ahead and wants the fee removed?
checks.no_fee_promises: Did the agent avoid promising that the fee would definitely be removed or changed?
checks.holding_message_reassuring: Did the reply tell the patient that someone from the front desk or billing team will review and get back to them, in a calm and respectful way?
